# Security Requirements Checklist: DevSecOps Security Baseline

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the security
requirements before implementation (requirements quality, not control verification).
**Created**: 2026-08-24
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the four scan classes (dependency/SCA, static/SAST, secret, artifact) each defined by a distinct requirement? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the required protective response headers enumerated rather than left as "protective headers"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the required session-cookie flags (secure, http-only, same-site) explicitly listed? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Is a valid risk acceptance fully specified (rationale, named owner, expiry/re-review)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the OWASP Top 10 review scope enumerated (all ten categories) rather than referenced generically? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for running the security checks locally, not only in CI? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is the "high-severity threshold" defined with a precise, objective severity mapping? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001/FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "explicitly accepted" defined with the concrete conditions that make an acceptance valid? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "secure-by-default" quantified via enumerated headers/cookie flags rather than left abstract? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "before release" for artifact scanning tied to a concrete release step? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "before it is marked complete" for the OWASP review tied to an observable completion gate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are the enforcement requirements (PR + push to `main`, required checks) consistent with feature 008's model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the no-secret requirements consistent across source, logs, and artifacts and aligned with features 011/012? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the severity threshold applied consistently across all four scan classes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001–FR-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the cookie-hardening requirement align with feature 003's session ownership without conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Can "100% of PRs/pushes trigger the security gates" be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Is "0 secrets in source, logs, or artifacts" measurable against a defined scan scope? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK018 Is SC-004 (headers on 100% of responses; hardened cookies) expressed as an objectively checkable outcome? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK019 Is "0 undocumented suppressions" verifiable against a defined record of acceptances? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK020 Are the "blocked in testing" criteria (SC-002/SC-003/SC-005) stated so each block is objectively demonstrable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002/SC-003/SC-005]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements defined for a scanning tool that errors or is unavailable (fail-loud, not silent pass)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for narrow suppression of false positives (per finding/location, not whole-check disable)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for handling generated/vendored/build-output files without excluding genuinely shipped code? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is expiry/re-review behavior for accepted risks specified rather than permanent suppression? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the CSP rollout (report-only → enforced) captured as a requirement or explicitly deferred to planning? [Gap, Spec §FR-004]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK026 Are the CI time/performance impacts of the added security jobs bounded or explicitly acknowledged? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Is "no runtime behavior change except added protective headers" stated unambiguously? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK028 Is cross-environment consistency (developer OS + automated environment) required for the gates? [Non-Functional, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Are the dependencies on features 008 (CI), 011 (logging), and 012 (artifact) documented? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the boundary with feature 003 (auth implemented there; baseline defined here) explicitly stated? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 Are out-of-scope items (DAST, penetration testing, WAF/IDS, compliance certification) explicitly recorded? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK032 Is there any ambiguity between "gates block merges" and the direct-push-to-`main` history noted in feature 008? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the documentation requirement (run locally + triage/accept findings) specific enough to validate against actual docs? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Focus areas: scan-gate rigor, secure-by-default configuration, and the OWASP review process
- Depth: Standard | Audience: Reviewer (PR)
- This checklist tests the **requirements' quality**, not whether the security controls work at runtime
